name: ares
description: Ares: diagnostics, fixes, hover, completion and formatting from the `ares lsp` server

ares.server.path.description: The `ares` executable. The server is started as `<path> [extraArgs] lsp`.

ares.lsp.check.markdownDescription: When the editor checks: as you type (`type`), or only when a file is saved (`save`). Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else `type`.

ares.lsp.focus.markdownDescription: How loudly errors are shown. `all`: every error at full strength. `roots`: errors that follow from an earlier one are quieter. `one`: only the most important error per file is an error. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else `roots`.

ares.lsp.debounce_ms.markdownDescription: How long typing must pause before the file is checked. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else 150.

ares.lsp.grace.markdownDescription: Hold back errors inside the definition being typed until typing pauses for `grace_ms`. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else true.

ares.lsp.grace_ms.markdownDescription: The pause after which held-back errors are shown. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else 1500.

ares.lsp.max_diagnostics.markdownDescription: The most diagnostics shown per file. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else 50.

ares.format.width.markdownDescription: The line width the formatter fits code into. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else 100.

ares.format.indent.markdownDescription: Spaces per indentation level. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else 4.

ares.lints.unreachable_arm.markdownDescription: A match arm no value can reach. Unset: the project's `BUILD.ares`, else `warn`.

ares.trace.server.description: Log the protocol traffic with the server to the Ares output channel.
